description: WOW! THE VIEWS! RENOVATED & GORGEOUS! Calabasas Lake living at its finest!  Location. Location. Location!!!  Rarely to be found, this lake home is renovated to utter perfection!  Located on a private cul-de-sac and near tennis courts, a swimming pool, spa and more! This renovated beauty exemplifies luxury lake living.  Inside find 3 bedrooms (1 down and 2 up). 3 full baths. The perfect combination of stone and wood floors. A fantastic chef’s kitchen with high grade Viking Appliances, sleek white cabinetry, modern stone countertops, open to the spacious living room, dining room and over looking the lake. Find 2 stone fireplaces, brand new bi-fold wall to wall folding doors.  Enjoy the upscale light fixtures throughout.  There is a conveniently located bedroom with full bath downstairs. A 2 car garage and designated laundry room. Upstairs find 2 additional bedrooms, renovated primary suite with a separate sitting room, spacious closet and a newly designed en-suite fit for a queen.   Wake up to Calabasas Lake views!  Don’t miss this rare find!
